infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Forge Legacy keeps measuring your run while your phone is locked or in your pocket, so the distance, pace and climb are the whole session rather than the part you were looking at. It is only read during a session you started, and the route is never shared.

plugins.photosPermission: Forge Legacy uses your photo library so you can add a squad photo, share progress in the feed, and build your transformation gallery.
plugins.cameraPermission: Forge Legacy uses your camera so you can record squad check-in videos and capture photos on the spot.
plugins.microphonePermission: Forge Legacy uses your microphone so your check-in and form-check videos have sound.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Forge Legacy uses your location while you're running, walking, or riding to measure the distance and pace of that session. It is only read during a session you started, and the route is never shared.
